tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show which Durmem store the presented key opens, with its name and domain when available. Use only to confirm which store a key belongs to; to learn what a store holds call loom_describe_store, and to read facts call loom_query or loom_read_probe_bundle. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: loom_describe_store
tools.description: Describe the Durmem store this key opens: what it holds, plus the server version and storage capacity when available. Use to learn what the store contains before querying; to read specific facts use loom_query or loom_read_probe_bundle. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: loom_query
tools.description: Run one named read-only Durmem rule and return its rows. Use for a structured read when you know the rule and its argument order, such as rule_name facts_by_groups on namespace default_root; for a natural-language question use loom_read_probe_bundle, and to learn what a store holds use loom_describe

tools.name: loom_read_probe_bundle
tools.description: Retrieve the most relevant Durmem facts, ranked and bounded, for a question or label query. Use for open natural-language questions and current-state answers; to run one specific read rule use loom_query, and to learn what a store holds use loom_describe_store. Requires at least one of query_text, l

tools.name: loom_save
tools.description: Save one fact to the store: a typed entity expression, its content, and optional [relation, target] edges. Use to write new memory; to read memory use loom_query or loom_read_probe_bundle. Returns a fact_id: the new fact's, or the existing live fact's when the same entity is saved again.

tools.name: loom_nearest_types
tools.description: Find the existing Durmem entity types most similar to a text, so you reuse one instead of minting a near-duplicate. Use before declaring a new type; to read facts use loom_query. Returns type names with neighbor counts and maximum similarity.
